items.finding: Behavior-spec midtraining is embedded in the existing mid-training progression; policy owner, weight candidate boundary, mis-specification/poisoning surface and runtime-enforcement fallback are explicit.

Preference-conditioned reward is placed after candidate-distribution drift and before policy optimization; profile identity, privacy/injection cost, unseen-preference failure and conservative fallback are explicit.
Phase-aware bounded loss follows the failure/straggler discussion; model/training and transport ownership, bitmap state, silent-corruption risk and reliable retransmit fallback are explicit.
Weight-gather is a conditional MoE Prefill branch, not a replacement; compute-window threshold, routing drift, memory/network failure and activation-dispatch fallback are explicit.
Bit-exact KV compression is charged to the complete handoff path; tensor/codebook identity, fixed overhead, CRC mismatch and uncompressed fallback are explicit.
Process compliance extends evaluation identity from final text to typed action traces and effect receipts; scripted/open-environment tradeoff and outcome separation are explicit.
Prompt variants are integrated as evaluation-distribution state; raw generations, parser identity, equivalence audit, added inference cost and bounded evidence scope are explicit.
